# Upstream workflow reference

The original REA workflows are preserved here for reference. They are inactive in this independent product repository: they include upstream releases, scheduled provider infrastructure, and website deployment tied to the original project. Their relative workflow references still describe the original layout.

The active product workflow is `../workflows/rea-rl-release.yml`. It checks the REA RL package on Windows and Ubuntu, builds release tarballs, and creates a GitHub Release for a matching `rea-rl-v*` tag.
